component.name: OmniMem
component.summary: Self-hosted semantic memory for AI agents

description.p: OmniMem gives Claude and other MCP clients a memory that lasts between sessions and projects: decisions, fixes, dead ends and the knowledge from the feeds you read, searched by meaning and kept on your own machine.
It runs in the tray, serving MCP at http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp, with a settings window for memories, projects, skills, feeds and backups.
